items.author: mod_ellenbrandt
items.title: PINNED: How to write a vendor review
items.body: Members, please keep reviews useful to colleagues. Include: the equipment (make and model), what work was done, date dropped off and date returned, what you were quoted and what you paid, and whether a loaner was offered. Say whether you paid personally or your employer did. Do not name cases, parties, counsel or judges. Keep it civil; criticism is welcome if it is specific. Start a new post per vendor visit. Ellen Brandt, Forum Moderator, Maryland Shorthand Reporters Circle

items.title: Anyone used Harbor Point in Towson?
items.body: My Aria 3 is double-stroking on the number bar and I can't afford to be without it for long. Has anyone had work done at Harbor Point Steno Service? The only other place I know is in Virginia and they want me to ship it. Dana

items.author: tsoriano_cr
items.title: Keystroke Logic (Richmond) - Lumen 9 cleaning, mail-in
items.body: Mailed my Lumen 9 in on 8/11, back 8/29. Quoted $195, paid $195 plus $40 return shipping. No loaner for mail-in. Work was fine. Paid personally. Would use again if I had a spare machine to cover the gap.

items.title: HP-4471: battery
items.body: Ms. Calloway, following up on my voicemail. Your internal battery is holding about 60% of rated capacity. Replacement is $25 parts and labor. I will not proceed without your approval. Gloria
